content.description: We have received your details and are excited to help upgrade your property with durable, high-quality concrete work.
trustPoints: Your request is already with our team
content.fastText: Be proactive and call us right now to speak directly with our scheduler!

content.title: It starts with a quick phone call
content.description: To get you an accurate quote and clear up any questions about your project scope, our process always begins with a quick phone call. Calling you directly is the absolute fastest and most efficient way to review your site requirements and get you on our scheduling calendar.

steps.title: We review your submission
steps.text: A member of our team goes through the details and the services you just sent us.

steps.title: We call you
steps.text: A short conversation covers your site requirements, your questions and the scope of the work.

steps.title: You get on the calendar
steps.text: With the scope settled, we book your project on our scheduling calendar.

items.title: During business hours
items.text: Our normal operating hours are Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. A member of our team will review your submission and call you at our earliest opportunity during these hours. Occasionally, we may call after 5, but we will not answer calls after 5.

items.title: Nights & weekends
items.hours: First thing the next business day
items.text: If you are submitting this request over the weekend or outside of our regular hours, rest assured we will give you a call or text first thing on the next business day.

content.title: Please save our official consultation numbers
content.description: So you know it's us calling or texting you — an unknown number is easy to miss.

content.title: Explore our credentials and past work
content.description: Everything here helps us have a shorter, sharper call when we reach you.

items.title: See work near you on our Project Map
items.text: Explore our interactive Project Map to find completed driveways, patios, and commercial concrete projects right in your neighborhood.

items.title: Our licensing, bonding, insurance & code compliance
items.text: Your property is protected. Read about our full licensing, robust liability insurance, structural bonding, and strict adherence to local Ohio building codes.

items.title: Browse our concrete transformation gallery
items.text: Visit our Gallery for inspiration and to view the craftsmanship of our stamped concrete, smooth finishes, and structural slabs.

content.title: Talk to you soon!
